title: Canonical tensor pullback respects normalized tensor model transport
statement: Let f:X→Y, commutative coefficient sheaves R on Y and S on X, and c:f inverse R ≅ S be as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let aY,bY and aX,bX be ordinary tensor models [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model], with isomorphisms eY,eX whose composites with the a representative maps are the b representative maps. For arbitrary derived M,N on Y, writing F for ordinary ringed derived pullback and alpha,beta for the canonical tensor-pullback comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], F(eY(M,N));beta(M,N)=alpha(M,N);eX(FM,FN).

proof.text: Use full faithfulness of product resolving-class restriction to test the natural transformation equality on flat-term K-flat pairs.

On such a pair use the defining representative equations for both canonical tensor-pullback comparisons. Precompose with F of the source representative map and postcompose with the target tensor of the two derived-pullback factorization maps, all isomorphisms.
The source normalization identifies the left side. Naturality of eX across the two factorization maps and its target representative normalization identify the right side. Cancel the isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorModelPullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    (aY bY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y R)
    (aX bX : ProEtaleTensorModel X S)
    (eY : aY.tensor ≅ bY.tensor) (eX : aX.tensor ≅ bX.tensor)
    (heY : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y R) ℤ)
      (hP : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y R P)
      (hQ : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y R Q),
      aY.representative.hom.app (⟨P, hP⟩, ⟨Q, hQ⟩) ≫
        eY.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) =
      bY.representative.hom.app (⟨P, hP⟩, ⟨Q, hQ⟩))
    (heX : ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules X S) ℤ)
      (hP : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives X S P)
      (hQ : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives X S Q),
      aX.representative.hom.app (⟨P, hP⟩, ⟨Q, hQ⟩) ≫
        eX.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) =
      bX.representative.hom.app (⟨P, hP⟩, ⟨Q, hQ⟩))
    (M N : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules Y R)) :
    let F := proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f R S c
    let α := proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison f
      R S
      c aY aX
    let β := proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison f
      R S
      c bY bX
    F.map (eY.hom.app (M, N)) ≫ β.hom.app (M, N) =
      α.hom.app (M, N) ≫ eX.hom.app (F.obj M, F.obj N)
